description: One free call before your agent pays or hires another: its latest statement (stale, age, chain_ok, flags), live incidents, its detections in the last 72 hours, the token approvals its wallet has given (unlimited ones, and any to a plain account), its last counted payment, and its payments seen after the statement window closed (from its 25 newest payments, so the hours a statement cannot show are not blind). Returns facts and which of the documented refuse conditions are met; the decision stays with you. The paid precheck pack adds what the address you were given to pay is.
